test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language. 'BOAT' is written as 'DQCV' and 'PLAN' is written as 'RNCP'. How will 'PHONE' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BOAT' is written as 'DQCV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66bf3ad3fb9ba1faba22c9df17eba13ad67dd6d2fefadd0a7ef18bfd73626d1a.png] 

'PLAN' is written as 'RNCP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23cb0c52ff57751fb015b4c48d3d26e125d9769b0b43eeafedb214d12e5647fa.png] 

Similarly, the code for '**PHONE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de59663d9fdd32f84b22d141a034748ea05c7c665e4b1cd2ccff896981310b42.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**RJQPG**".
